description: This file contains the implementation of the SMTP class for PHPMailer, providing methods for connecting, communicating, and handling SMTP protocol operations, including authentication, data transmission, and extensions.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: Implements RFC 821 SMTP commands, utility methods for email transmission, connection management, authentication, and SMTP extensions.

methods.name: edebug
methods.description: Outputs debug information according to the specified debug level and output method.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SMTP server, handling connection parameters and initial server announcement.

methods.name: getSMTPConnection
methods.description: Creates the socket connection to the SMTP server, with fallback handling.

methods.name: startTLS
methods.description: Initiates a TLS encryption session over an existing connection.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication using various methods such as PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5, or XOAUTH2.

methods.name: hmac
methods.description: Computes an MD5 HMAC hash, compatible with hash_hmac if available.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the SMTP socket connection is active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SMTP socket and resets connection state.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Sends message data after a DATA command, handling line normalization and dot-stuffing.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Sends HELO or EHLO command to identify the client to the server.

methods.name: sendHello
methods.description: Low-level method to send HELO/EHLO and parse server responses.

methods.name: parseHelloFields
methods.description: Parses server reply to HELO/EHLO to discover server extensions.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Sends MAIL FROM command to initiate mail transmission.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Sends QUIT command and closes the connection.

methods.name: recipient
methods.description: Adds a recipient using RCPT TO command, with optional DSN notifications.

methods.name: xclient
methods.description: Sends XCLIENT command to relay client connection info, if supported.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Sends RSET command to abort current transaction.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Low-level method to send SMTP command and check expected response codes.

methods.name: sendAndMail
methods.description: Sends SAML command for message relaying to local users.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Sends VRFY command to verify email address existence.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: Sends NOOP command to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: turn
methods.description: Placeholder for TURN command (not implemented).

methods.name: client_send
methods.description: Sends raw data over SMTP connection with debug logging.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves error details from last SMTP operation.

methods.name: getServerExtList
methods.description: Returns list of SMTP extensions supported by server.

methods.name: getServerExt
methods.description: Retrieves information about specific SMTP extensions or server capabilities.

methods.name: getLastReply
methods.description: Returns the last reply string received from the server.

methods.name: setVerp
methods.description: Enables or disables VERP address generation.

methods.name: getVerp
methods.description: Returns current VERP setting.

methods.name: setSMTPUTF8
methods.description: Enables or disables SMTPUTF8 support.

methods.name: getSMTPUTF8
methods.description: Returns current SMTPUTF8 support status.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets SMTP connection timeout.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves SMTP connection timeout.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Handles errors during stream operations, records error info.

methods.name: recordLastTransactionID
methods.description: Extracts and records SMTP transaction ID from server reply.

methods.name: getLastTransactionID
methods.description: Returns the last SMTP transaction ID recorded.
